checks: Both tools are stdlib-only and do not launch or import HF/HP/solver/tests/observer/plot programs.
BASE e687 and alpha_reference_001 REL are fixed; only new stage files and two existing fronts may form the exact staged delta; old24 prepared-stage files remain unchanged.
Configuration requires the sole closed pass/4HP/2mechanical/body result and four independent review statuses; it preserves actual status rather than inventing future execution.
Configuration copies only its explicit ordinary author list, preserves both front histories and closes all39 run files; publication validates the exact closed run set, no success-only subset.
Old48 source/input bindings use original manifest entries; old10 NPZ are never opened or hashed by these tools, while ordinary source pins are checked.
New run file identity hashing is streaming raw bytes as publication bookkeeping; no NPZ decode or HP calculation. The reviewer did not invoke it and used stat/declarations only.
Prior prepared source-publication proof and old manifest SHA/count/bytes/BASE identities are inherited; unrelated old entries remain exact.

Finalize permits only exact new|FRONTS staged delta and preserves no deletions; verify requires sole BASE child commit, main/origin, remote equality, source+restore clean and complete raw newdelta identity.
PASS transport guards outer exit0/stopNone/fullwindow budgets/source unchanged, 4HP/2states, index0/1 versus13/14, continuation/gates and false original-path/pressure/clamp/HF5 qualifications.
NOT_PASS transport branch retains actual incomplete/corrupt/missing snapshots honestly and cannot reclassify computation as pass; current config is intentionally for this actual PASS only.
limits: Future publisher raw byte verification and commit/push/restore remain unexecuted by reviewer.
All scientific input/output arrays and gzip archives are declaration/stat only in this review; no current raw byte re-audit claim.
